de38db5886b5d83323263e8c702bb724.overview: In Japan's Aokigahara Forest, a troubled teacher meets a mysterious lost stranger who takes him on a life-changing journey of love and redemption.

de6351562b7c7931539fbae9ef522743.overview: A short film depicting a man whose head grotesquely melts. Originally created as an ident bumper that occasionally played before screenings at the Cinefamily cinematheque. Directed by Sammy Harkham with special make-up effects by Odd Studio.

de70cf75ae1419af69019f55dd37421a.overview: A racist insurance agent lives in a typical suburban neighborhood, but his bigoted world of taunting and harassing black people on and off the job is turned upside down when his skin inexplicably turns dark overnight.
de70cf75ae1419af69019f55dd37421a.tagline: His white bread world just turned upside brown!

de863b0ff91d37455973dc87048172eb.overview: Dick died last night, and Zeke and Earl don’t want anybody finding out how. That’s too bad though, cause news travels fast in small-town Alabama.

deb24f8ef4739892ace07070e4c2c6bc.overview: Captain Vinka Kovalenko defects from Russia, but not for political reasons. She defects because she feels discriminated against as a woman. Captain Chuck Lockwood gets the order to show her the bright side of capitalism, while she tries to convince him of the superiority of communism. Naturally, they fall in love, but there's still the KGB, which doesn't like the idea of having a defected Russian officer running around in London.

ded7a27b3b504c2bea77b20aadb4b70c.overview: The life of a Russian physician and poet who, although married to another, falls in love with a political activist's wife and experiences hardship during World War I and then the October Revolution.
ded7a27b3b504c2bea77b20aadb4b70c.tagline: A Love Caught in the Fire of Revolution

dee02c6806b5bc23892965bd001180b3.overview: 25-year-old Dwayne McLaren, a former athlete turned auto mechanic, dreams of getting out of tiny Cut Bank, Montana the coldest town in America. But his effort to do so sets in motion a deadly series of events that change his life and the life of the town forever...

dee9ffff9d67c5a8d349f04be6446555.overview: Karl Anton Verloc and his wife own a small cinema in a quiet London suburb where they live seemingly happily. But Mrs. Verloc does not know that her husband has a secret that will affect their relationship and threaten her teenage brother's life.
dee9ffff9d67c5a8d349f04be6446555.tagline: A bomb plot... A Killing... Justice.
